phases.name: Shared contract and pure view rules

tasks.title: Define the shared TaskViewProps contract
tasks.description: client/src/features/tasks/views/types.ts plus the exports in index.ts, so every view takes tasks and callbacks from the page and no view fetches (CON-111).

tasks.title: Write the shared scheduling maths
tasks.description: lib/schedule.ts: getStartKey, rescheduleToDeadline, shiftTask, resizeTask, buildMonthGrid, groupByDeadline, buildTimeline, groupDaysByMonth and getLinkPath, all in calendar days.

tasks.title: Write the board rules as pure helpers
tasks.description: lib/boardQuickFilters.ts, lib/swimlanes.ts, lib/wip.ts, lib/pagination.ts and lib/columnSwipe.ts with their unit tests.

tasks.title: Write the list column and selection rules
tasks.description: lib/listColumns.ts (built-in and custom columns, visibility, custom number/date sorting, grid template) and lib/selection.ts (toggle, range, all, prune).

tasks.title: Write the calendar day summaries and phone modes
tasks.description: lib/calendarDots.ts (urgency order, three dots, overflow, accessible summary), lib/agenda.ts (days with tasks, Upcoming) and lib/week.ts (week strip, remembered mode, task range label).

tasks.title: Keep view, filter and board state in the URL
tasks.description: lib/filters.ts (filter parameters, safe fallbacks, cf.<key>) and hooks/useBoardSettings.ts (useBoardUrlState for ?col/?qf/?group, useIsDesktop, WIP limits with a tolerant read).

tasks.title: Render the board columns and drag and drop
tasks.description: BoardView: columns per workflow stage with counts, epic exclusion, native HTML5 drag and drop, drop position from lib/filters.getDropPosition and the stage/status patch.

tasks.title: Add the phone board interactions
tasks.description: One column at a time with the sticky segmented switcher, ?col=, swipe (lib/columnSwipe), Arrow/Home/End keys, per-card quick move, Move-to sheet from the menu and the 500 ms long press, plus the reduced-motion-aware slide.

tasks.title: Add board quick filters, swimlanes, WIP and pagination
tasks.description: BoardQuickFilters.tsx, BoardSwimlanes.tsx, the over-limit warning in the column header and per-column "Show more" pagination; the WipLimitsDialog saves through useBoardSettings.

tasks.title: Render the list table and cards with inline editing
tasks.description: ListView: grid table from md up and phone cards, InlineText/InlineDate/StatusSelect/PrioritySelect editing under canWrite, subtask arrangement, the Columns menu and custom column sorting.

tasks.title: Add list selection and the bulk action bar
tasks.description: Row and header checkboxes with the indeterminate state, Shift+click ranges, Esc to clear, and BulkActionBar applying one patch or deleting the selection after confirmation.

tasks.title: Render the calendar month grid with drag to reschedule
tasks.description: CalendarView: six-week grid, task placement by due day, native drag and drop calling rescheduleToDeadline, and "add a task" on a day prefilled with that date under canWrite.

tasks.title: Add the calendar dots, agenda and phone modes
tasks.description: Urgency dots with overflow, the text summary and legend, the phone week strip and compact month grid with the remembered mode, the Upcoming list and the Today action with its "t" shortcut.

tasks.title: Render the Gantt timeline with arrows and rescheduling
tasks.description: TimelineView: bars from getStartKey to the deadline, month header segments, dependency arrows with conflict marking, day/week zoom, pointer drag move/resize, keyboard Arrow and Shift+Arrow, and useLiveHold during a drag.

tasks.title: Wire the view, filters and permissions into the task page
tasks.description: TaskPage: ?view= switching that keeps filters, filter application with fallbacks for stale label/epic targets, loading skeleton, error alert, distinct empty states and the canWrite/canDelete capabilities passed to the views.

tasks.title: Cover the views' rendering and callbacks
tasks.description: views.test.tsx plus components.test.tsx, permissions.test.tsx and workflowBoard.test.tsx: columns, empty states, inline editing, quick actions, no-write access.

tasks.title: Cover the interaction paths
tasks.description: board.test.tsx, boardFeatures.test.tsx, boardUrlState.test.tsx, calendar.test.tsx and bulkEdit.test.tsx: swipe, tabs with Arrow/Home/End, long press, drag and drop, dots, Today, selection and bulk actions.

tasks.title: Unit test the pure helpers
tasks.description: boardQuickFilters, swimlanes, wip, pagination, selection, listColumns, schedule, calendarDots, agenda, week, columnSwipe, filters and date tests (CON-202).

tasks.title: Pass typecheck, lint, tests and build
tasks.description: pnpm --filter client typecheck && pnpm --filter client test && pnpm --filter client lint; pnpm --filter client build, and the server gates for the board-settings endpoint it depends on (CON-402).
